title: SharePoint: automatically archive inactive files with an Advanced Management policy
summary: Hold: the enforcement guidance omits Microsoft's exception for policies covering more than 100,000 sites. Switching such an existing simulation policy to enforcement can skip sites already evaluated; Microsoft says to create a new enforcement policy instead. The commands, licensing, billing and roadmap facts otherwise have supporting evidence.

claims.claim: After report review, the existing simulation policy can be switched to enforcement without a scope-dependent exception.
claims.quote: If your policy covers more than 100,000 sites, create a new policy with the same criteria, scope, and site inclusions or exclusions when you're ready to archive files. Set `IsWhatIfMode` to `$false` on the new policy.
claims.fix: Add after the enforcement instruction: "For a policy covering more than 100,000 sites, create a new policy with the same criteria, scope and site inclusions or exclusions and set IsWhatIfMode to $false on that new policy. Switching the existing simulation policy resumes its previous processing position and may skip sites already evaluated in simulation." Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/archive/manage-inactive-files?view=o365-worldwide#review-simulation-results

claims.claim: Medium risk is justified by what the policy does after opt-in rather than exposure at its default.
claims.quote:
defaultState: "admin-opt-in"
risk: "medium"
rationale: "Learn describes a policy as inactive until an admin activates it, but once it is active and out of simulation, files past the inactivity threshold are archived"
claims.fix: Set risk to "low" and replace the risk rationale with "Low. The policy is created inactive and archives nothing until an administrator activates it outside simulation mode." The standard rates a new control at its default and defines nothing happening until admin opt-in as low risk.

claims.fix: The first Before rollout bullet checks Archive enablement and billing connection, which have no controls-table row. Remove that checklist bullet; retain the supported Archive prerequisites in Scope. Do not add a row.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout, second bullet; Governance controls

claims.quote: "Search the audit log for the FileArchived activity to investigate what a policy archived"; the table's review row gives Get-SPOFileArchivePolicyReport, not an audit-log search control.
claims.fix: The After rollout bullet directing an audit-log search has no matching controls-table row. Remove that checklist bullet; retain the independently supported FileArchived information in Risk assessment. Do not add a row.
